provenance.note: Every bar in Figures 2 and 3 prints its exact percentage, so these baselines are transcribed values, not visual estimates of bar heights. Each series was read from the linked PNG and cross-checked for a 100% total per operating system. This file was written by hand with tool assistance and was not derived from any recomputation; re-verify against the linked images before relying on it.

boundary_caveat: The paper never states whether a bin label such as 10-30 is [10,30) or (10,30], how zero involved-function records are placed, or where censored counts such as 10+ belong. This file therefore records only the published bar labels and the numeric edges they imply; the binning convention itself is deliberately left undefined and handled by the sensitivity analysis.
